decisions.statement: A change to a file quiet for its cooldown is written at once.
A change arriving sooner waits out the rest of that cooldown.
Only the last change to arrive in a cooldown is written when that cooldown ends.
A line the same as the line already written is not written again.
A change back to the line already written leaves nothing waiting.
A cooldown is counted from the last write of one file alone.
Nothing here reads a clock or opens a file.

definition: when a state file is written again and when the writing waits
